en_title: GTA 6 Estimated to Have Reached 20 Million Preorders Ahead of Launch
cn_title: 据估计，《GTA6》发售前的预购量已达2000万份
opus_summary: 分析师估计，《GTA6》正式发售前的预购销量约为2000万份。Sensor Tower数据显示，截至11月16日，该游戏售出1707万份，收入已超过16亿美元(约合人民币107亿元)，其中PS5销量占75%，XBOX Series占25%。Rockstar尚未公布官方预购或销售数据。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 sold around 20 million copies via preorders before the game's general release, analysts estimate.
paragraphs.cn: 分析师估计，《GTA6》在游戏正式发售前通过预购售出了约2000万份。

paragraphs.en: Data published by Sensor Tower shows 17.07 million copies sold by November 16, with still a couple of days to go before launch. By that point, GTA 6's daily pre-order sales were averaging over a million per day, making the 20 million copy milestone a likely estimate for Rockstar's blockbuster — even before it officially went on sale.
paragraphs.cn: Sensor Tower发布的数据显示，截至11月16日，游戏已售出1707万份，而距离发售仍有几天。届时，《GTA6》的日均预购销量已超过100万份，这使得Rockstar这款大作即使尚未正式开售，销量达到2000万份里程碑的估计也颇有可能。

paragraphs.en: Sensor Tower data suggests the game has already surpassed $1.6 billion in revenue, with 75% of sales for PlayStation 5 and just 25% on Xbox Series X/S.
paragraphs.cn: Sensor Tower的数据显示，这款游戏的收入已超过16亿美元，其中75%的销量来自PS5，XBOX Series仅占25%。

paragraphs.en: While Rockstar is yet to release any official preorder or sales numbers itself, it seems that shareholders in its parent company, Take-Two, are happy. Take-Two's share price remains lower than its all-time high set around this time last year, during the midst of the GTA 6 hype cycle, but the company's stocks have risen steadily over the course of this month.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Rockstar自身尚未公布任何官方预购或销售数据，但其母公司Take-Two的股东似乎很满意。Take-Two的股价仍低于去年这个时候、即《GTA6》热潮期间创下的历史最高点，但该公司股价在本月稳步上涨。

paragraphs.en: Yesterday's publication of reviews — which left GTA 6 as the joint-highest rated game of all time — helped drive this further, with shares rising 6% from a low of $203 on November 17 to a high of $222 when markets closed last night. And, of course, it likely won't be long before Take-Two reveals just how well GTA 6 has officially done. Any guesses?
paragraphs.cn: 昨天发布的评测使《GTA6》并列成为有史以来评分最高的游戏，也帮助股价进一步上涨：股价从11月17日的203美元低点上涨6%，至昨晚收盘时达到222美元的高点。当然，Take-Two或许很快就会正式公布《GTA6》的表现究竟有多好。有什么猜测吗？

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick told IGN in an interview that he was feeling “optimistic” about the launch of GTA 6, with preorders tracking “far in excess” of the company’s initial expectations.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，Take-Two负责人Strauss Zelnick在接受IGN采访时表示，他对《GTA6》的发售感到「乐观」，预购情况「远远超出」公司的最初预期。

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips .
